limits: Temporary homes and synthetic rollout content. The token-ID path is exercised only with token IDs added to items in the test: no SPEC-074 triplet carries them. The comparison of lines with a written manifest is procedure_005 and procedure_006, balance procedure_007, and the canary scan procedure_010. Transition records carry the attempt's reward vector, not a per-call reward. Trajectory records keep only the attempt's exported calls, so an excluded middle call leaves a gap inside turnRange (declared text-level-merge, never a token-ID merge). The writers share one loop (_write) with the supervised writer, whose limits follow the same rule. The terms gate refuses host-model output without an owner record (procedure_008).
outcome: passed: T005: lightning_export.rollout_records writes {recordId, rolloutId, attemptId (pseudonym), turns [{prompt, response, toolCalls}], reward, status} as trace_adapter.canonical_bytes plus a newline, with a manifest record entry whose sha256 is the line's SHA-256 and which validates against the schema's record item. A three-call succeeded rollout (one non-ASCII call, one with a tool call) yields three transition records with turnRange [0,0], [1,1], [2,2] and no limits, each carrying the attempt's SPEC-071 reward vector unchanged and status succeeded, and one trajectory record with three turns, turnRange [0, 2], outcome success and limit text-level-merge (adapter triplets carry no token IDs). With token IDs on every turn of consecutive calls forming a prefix chain the trajectory declares no limit; a broken chain, a turn without token IDs, a non-integer token ID, or a chain whose middle call was excluded (turnRange [0, 2] with two turns) gives text-level-merge; token IDs never enter a record. A one-call failed rollout merges nothing and carries status failed. A rollout with two attempts is refused by read_runs with source-invalid and a fixed text. Order is E3 (task before rollout: a rollout id that sorts first but belongs to a later task comes last) and independent of input order. The T004 checks apply: host-model items refuse with terms-gate-missing at both levels, unselected items with invalid-argument, an unknown level with invalid-argument, and a written record outside the shape (tool calls not a list) with invalid-record. check_rollout refuses an unknown key, a raw attempt id, no turns, an unknown turn key, non-text turn text, tool calls that are not a list, a non-object reward or one with other keys, an unknown status and a malformed record id. No raw attempt id reaches a line or entry. Negative controls (mutants, each fails a test): token-ID merge ignored, the limit never declared, the prefix check dropped, the consecutive-call check dropped, the one-attempt check dropped, check_rollout removed, the input and terms check removed, the reward dropped.
